groups.defect: The async Legacy.Update gets the original objInfo instead of an updateWrapper holding the Storage result, so the legacy store can end up inconsistent with Storage.
groups.rationale: Both point at the same Update goroutine and report the same lost updateWrapper/consistency problem, with the same fix.

groups.defect: The async legacy write takes its context from the request context, so the write is canceled once the response returns. The same applies to the Delete, Update and DeleteCollection paths.
groups.rationale: Both report the same cancellation problem at Create lines 50-57. One also notes that the other async paths need the same fix.

groups.defect: Duration metrics go to the wrong backend: Storage failures in Create and Update are recorded with recordLegacyDuration, and the legacy DeleteCollection timing is recorded with recordStorageDuration.
groups.rationale: The same mistake (swapped storage/legacy record functions) appears in several methods, and each place needs its own edit.
